data.question: What are the hit dice of Bard?

passages.document_title: Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM
Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM

passages.text: Long Rest . It fills up all your Hit Dice now. This is kinda a meh change for me.
passages.document_title: Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM

passages.text: 1st Level: Bardic Inspiration . Your die initially is a d6 but increases to d8, d10, and d12 at levels 5, 10, and 15 respectively. The number of dice is equal to your Proficiency Bonus and they refresh after a Long Rest. A thing to note here is that using Bardic Inspiration now requires your Reaction instead of your Bonus Action. But what does it do?
passages.document_title: Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM
Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM

passages.text: I like that the flavour text for the Bard tries to give the idea that not all entertainers are Bards. Those who are Bards “harness the Words of Creation”.
passages.document_title: Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM
Unearthed Arcana 2022: Expert Classes Analysis – The Kind GM
